nodes.label: Apex Logistics Ltd.
nodes.description: Regional refrigerated distribution supplier requesting $250k working capital.

nodes.label: Prime Credit Score: 742
nodes.description: Owner personal credit score 742, clean payment history on small tier credit lines.

nodes.label: Collateral: $320,000
nodes.description: Refrigerated fleet and warehouse inventory pledged at 128% loan-to-value.

nodes.label: 84% Revenue via Retailer TitanMart
nodes.description: Form detail: Long-standing supply contract delivering 84% of gross revenue to TitanMart Corp.

nodes.label: Accounts Receivable DSO: 45 Days
nodes.description: Form shows historical average collection period of 45 days.

nodes.label: TitanMart PE Restructuring & Margin Squeeze
nodes.description: Unwritten industry intel: TitanMart was bought out by aggressive PE; currently unilaterally extending vendor payment terms to 90+ days and demanding 12% price cuts.

nodes.label: Specialized Chilled Fleet Illiquidity
nodes.description: Officer's market experience: Used refrigerated vans face 40% liquidation discount at auction; effective recoverable collateral is under $190k.

nodes.label: Monopsony Price-Taker Fragility
nodes.description: Apex has zero pricing power. Inability to pass through cost inflation or resist contract renegotiation.

nodes.label: Working Capital Freeze & DSCR Collapse
nodes.description: Extending DSO from 45 to 90 days creates an immediate $210,000 liquidity hole. DSCR collapses from 1.35x to 0.38x.

nodes.label: Severe Default & Illiquidity Risk
nodes.description: High probability of loan default within 9 months when loan amortization starts.

nodes.label: DECISION: REJECT APPLICATION
nodes.description: Decline loan request despite 742 credit score and 128% paper collateral.

nodes.label: Beacon Precision Ltd.
nodes.description: Precision CNC aerospace & medical components manufacturer requesting $250k expansion loan.

nodes.label: Prime Credit Score: 738
nodes.description: Owner credit score 738, one 30-day late utility payment 2 years ago (explained).

nodes.label: Collateral: $310,000
nodes.description: 5-Axis DMG Mori CNC machining center with active maintenance records.

nodes.label: Q2 Operating Cash Dip (-$65,000)
nodes.description: Form detail: Bank statements show a temporary cash contraction in Q2 due to specialized tooling & ISO-13485 audit expenditures.

nodes.label: 22 Recurring Clients (Max Single = 9%)
nodes.description: Form detail: Revenue spread across 22 aerospace and medical technology buyers with 3-year recurring contracts.

nodes.label: ISO-13485 High Switching-Cost Moat
nodes.description: Officer's industry expertise: Medical device aerospace audits take 14 months to qualify. Once qualified, clients rarely switch suppliers due to re-certification costs.

nodes.label: 5-Axis CNC Global Liquidity
nodes.description: Officer knows DMG Mori 5-axis machines maintain 85%+ resale value globally; auction resale takes <3 weeks.

nodes.label: High Customer Retention & Pricing Power
nodes.description: Diversified customer base with qualified supplier status gives Beacon pricing power and predictable margins.

nodes.label: Contracted Cashflow Expansion & DSCR > 2.1x
nodes.description: Audit completion unlocks signed purchase orders. Projected DSCR rises to 2.15x over loan term.

nodes.label: Robust Debt-Service Capacity (Low Risk)
nodes.description: Resilient multi-channel cash generation ensures prompt interest and principal repayment.

nodes.label: DECISION: APPROVE APPLICATION
nodes.description: Approve $250,000 facility with standard covenant of quarterly financial reviews.
